instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Independent power producer operating a portfolio of 12 solar photovoltaic plants and 3 onshore wind farms across Iberia with a combined capacity of 180 MW. Selling electricity through PPAs and spot market, the company faces increasing demand for grid modernization solutions to handle intermittent renewables. They are actively evaluating battery storage co-location strategies and integrating AI-driven production forecasting models into their operational planning.
answers.pastInitiatives: We successfully deployed a new CRM system across the sales team 18 months ago, which improved lead tracking and reduced pipeline data entry time by 30%. The implementation was well-planned with dedicated project management and training. Building on this success, we are now exploring marketing automation integration and AI-assisted lead scoring.
answers.strategicGoals: Our industry is facing structural decline due to technological disruption and changing consumer behavior. We cannot rely on incremental improvements to our legacy business—we need to identify entirely new value propositions that leverage our brand, customer relationships, or operational capabilities in adjacent spaces where demand is growing, not shrinking.
answers.additionalContext: The company is currently scaling operations quickly, which strains existing processes and requires more formalized governance to manage the complexity of integrating new technologies.
answers.teamSize: We have a small technology team of 4-6 people including developers, a part-time DevOps engineer, and a product manager who also handles project management. The team is fully allocated to maintaining current products and handling integration requests from key clients. Innovation work is done in the margins—there is no formally ring-fenced innovation time or budget.

opportunities.title: Grid Optimization SaaS Platform Development
opportunities.rationale: Given the strategic priority of diversification and high competitive pressure, developing a software solution that uses predictive analytics to optimize energy flow for smaller grid operators offers a high-growth adjacent market. This moves Helix from being purely an asset owner (generation) to a technology enabler.

first_actions: Conduct market validation interviews with 5 small regional utilities in the Iberian market.
Form a dedicated, cross-functional 'Incubator Team' of 3 people for 3 months.
execution_plan.success_metric: Secure 2 pilot contracts with utilities within 6 months.
milestones: Month 1: Market research and problem definition
Month 3: MVP feature set defined and initial prototype build
Month 6: Finalize commercialization strategy for initial outreach

opportunities.title: AI-Powered Predictive Maintenance for Assets
opportunities.rationale: Implementing machine learning models to monitor wind turbine and solar plant performance in real-time can drastically reduce unexpected downtime, thereby lowering operational expenditure (OpEx) and improving asset reliability. This leverages existing digital maturity.

first_actions: Audit existing sensor data streams from the 12 PV and 3 wind sites to identify high-priority failure points.
Select a low-cost, off-the-shelf IoT platform (e.g., Azure Digital Twins) for initial integration.
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduce unscheduled downtime by 15% within the first year.
milestones: Month 1: Data pipeline establishment and baseline performance metrics established
Month 4: Initial ML model deployed on wind asset monitoring
Month 9: Model refinement leading to actionable maintenance alerts

next_steps.action: Establish a formal, ring-fenced 'Horizon 2' innovation fund with defined success metrics and governance structure.
Initiate the discovery phase for Grid Optimization SaaS, including hiring a fractional business development consultant.

key_weaknesses: Inconsistent innovation process: Lack of formal mechanisms to move projects from idea generation to execution limits scalability.
Fragmented digital infrastructure: Ad-hoc system integrations hinder data flow necessary for sophisticated AI and operational insights.
Limited internal technical expertise in advanced ML/AI: The small tech team is overwhelmed by maintenance tasks, leaving no capacity for strategic development.
Tight budget constraints: Reliance on a very low budget percentage (14%) severely limits the ability to fund high-risk, long-term diversification projects.
